methods.how_to:
## Get your Replicate API token

1. Go to [replicate.com](https://replicate.com) and sign in (or create an account).
2. Open **Account → API tokens**.
3. Click **Create token**, name it (e.g. `Cowork`), and copy it. Tokens start with `r8_`.
4. Paste the token into the **API Token** field below.

## Cost

- Replicate is a paid service. Each generated image is billed to your account; small image models cost a fraction of a cent per image.
- New accounts use prepaid credit: buy a small amount (a few dollars) under **Account → Billing**. Work stops when the balance reaches zero, so the credit you buy is your spending cap.
- Turn on billing email alerts in the same page to see when credit runs low.

## Notes

- Keep the token private; anyone with it can spend your credit. Delete it under **Account → API tokens** if it is exposed.
